subject: Collaborative MAP: bootstrapping the evaluation doc and close timeline
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena@solstice.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 09:24:00 -0800
Subject: Collaborative MAP: bootstrapping the evaluation doc and close timeline

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As promised, I pulled together a lightweight MAP (mutual action plan) template specifically focused on a tight evaluation and close cadence for inference pilots. The goal is to make it easy for your team to co-author acceptance criteria, testing matrix, and a realistic 30-day close timeline.

Quick ask: can you and Tom confirm the core stakeholders who should be co-authors (engineering, security, procurement)? Once you confirm I’ll drop a Google Doc and propose two 30–45 minute co-author sessions next week to align acceptance tests and gate dates.

What I attached / shared below:
- MAP-bootstrapping-template.gdoc (starter sections: objectives, success metrics, test matrix, data/security checklist)
- 30d-close-timeline.xlsx (example milestones and owners)
- SOC2-summary.pdf (short answer for your security team; full report available on request / NDA)

Suggested next steps:
1) Quick reply with co-author roster (names + roles)
2) Pick 1 co-author session: Tue 12/22 10am PT or Wed 12/23 11am PT
3) We’ll populate acceptance tests in the doc and lock the go/no-go criteria

If those slots don’t work, propose two alternatives and we’ll accommodate.

Thanks — looking forward to co-authoring this and keeping momentum.

Best,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0194

Attachments: MAP-bootstrapping-template.gdoc (link), 30d-close-timeline.xlsx (attachment), SOC2-summary.pdf (attachment)
From: Elena Torres <elena@solstice.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@solstice.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Collaborative MAP: bootstrapping the evaluation doc and close timeline

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for sending this over — the template looks like a good fit. Quick thoughts from our side:
- Co-authors: Tom Nguyen (Platform Lead), Maria Velasquez (SRE), and Priya Iyer (Procurement). I’ve copied Tom here; I’ll add Maria and Priya once I have permission to share their emails.
- Security / data handling: can you confirm whether the pilot uses token-level logs and what the default retention window is? Tom will want the SOC2 summary and a short note about customer-managed keys (KMS).
- Timeline: we’re eager to accelerate but we have a year-end freeze from 12/24–1/2 for vendor onboarding. If we want a 30-day close, we’ll need to start the co-author session this week.

If you can do a session tomorrow (Fri 12/18) at 9am PT that would help — otherwise next Monday morning is our fallback. Also please attach the preferred contact for procurement pricing questions.

Elena
Head of Product, Solstice AI
elena@solstice.ai | +1 312-555-0178

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena@solstice.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 08:06:00 -0800
Subject: Draft MAP doc + proposed co-author session (Fri 12/18 09:00 PT)

Hi Elena / Tom —

I created a draft Google Doc for the MAP and pre-populated sections with suggested acceptance tests we typically run for inference pilots (latency thresholds, sample workloads, failover verification, quality checks + evaluation prompts). Link below.

Doc: MAP-bootstrapping-template.gdoc — https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MAP-bootstrapping-template
Spreadsheet: 30d-close-timeline.xlsx — attached to this thread (sheet: milestones).

We can run the co-author session today at 9:00am PT. Agenda (30–45 min):
- 5m intros & objectives
- 15m acceptance criteria & test ownership
- 10m timeline & gating dates (who signs off when)
- 10m open Qs (security, procurement items)

Ben is on copy for pricing/consumption questions and Jasmine will facilitate the session and capture edits in the doc. If we confirm, I’ll send the calendar invite with the doc linked and action owners pre-assigned.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Attachments: 30d-close-timeline.xlsx (attachment)
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena@solstice.ai>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@solstice.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 19 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Collaborative MAP: bootstrapping the evaluation doc and close timeline

Thanks all — great sync today.

Recap / confirmed next steps:
- Co-author session held 12/18; doc link updated with action items (see Assigned section in the doc).
- Security questions: default retention for pilot logs is 7 days; we can enable customer-managed keys (KMS) for longer preservation — Ben will follow up with a short KMS note and full SOC2 artifact on request (Ben: posting the SOC2 summary link next business day).
- Procurement: Ben to provide pricing band options and a draft SOW template for a 30d pilot (Ben: please attach to the doc).
- Acceptance gates: we agreed on three gates — functionality smoke tests, acceptance on latency and quality thresholds, and a final ops readiness review by Solstice SRE.

Elena — please share Maria and Priya’s emails when you can so we can make them co-authors. I’ve updated the timeline spreadsheet to reflect the year-end freeze and shifted the go/no-go to 1/08/2027 in the doc.

I’ll keep the doc open for edits and we’ll aim to have finalized acceptance tests and owners by EOD 12/22.

Best,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.ai
